context: User requested continuing after expectation approval. Implement and verify C1-C5 offline; C6 remains gated by a separate new exact budget authorization.
decision: Use one source-bound campaign request and exact outer authorization covering ordered reviewed cases, model, rubric and global limits. Debit before dispatch; stop first technical failure; reject retries/resume. Reuse existing local supervisor without adding an agent framework or migrating historical approval.

summary: Add opt-in development campaign with one global deadline, at most 16 charged invocations, source recheck per worker, immutable claims and offline replay; reuse existing v4 flow and process supervision. Preserve earlier compatibility replay in its original frozen package. Subsequent exact PO authorization consumed in completed 16-call campaign; see DOC-0058 for replay, initial failures and pending output review. Subsequent actual PO judgment recorded in DOC-0059: six exact cases pass/two fail, 45/3/0 criteria. No correction or new-call authority.
